note: PROPOSAL for the owner. Nothing here is decided. v2 follows review loop 1 (findings 13-15) after the first full run, in which the default brain scored at chance. rules.v1.json is kept unchanged as the superseded record. v2 is committed and hash-pinned (rules.pin.json) before the re-run.

sc4.rationale: Proves the tasks can be answered from card content and that the harness sees content removed: opaque ids with content must beat opaque ids with nothing by >= 15 pp (paired 95% CI upper bound < 0 for empty minus content), empty must sit within +-10 pp of the 20% chance rate, and content must reach 35%. The arm is the non-candidate arm with the highest M1, fixed by role (reference), not chosen after seeing results.

rules.also: O-item false answers <= the default's count
rules.rationale: R1 is measured against the reference (stock) arm: against a chance-level default it is vacuous. The O-count clause is informational while every arm is at the floor; a default brain's abstain must stay code-enforced (retrieval withholds unrelated cards).
A default must not regress the everyday lab; 5 pp is 1 turn in 20.
Template is Buddy's shipping answer mode.
Measured against the better of the default and the reference arm: against a chance-level default even an untrained stand-in clears +10 pp. R4 then carries the stock comparison, still gated by R11.
Otherwise stock Qwen3 is the simpler choice and the distillation did not help Buddy.
Format failures are visible on every turn.
Echoing a planted secret is a leak class.
A 1.7B model costs about 1.3-1.5x a 1.2B one; compare on the same runner type.
The default ships to strangers; an unsealed release candidate fails the program's own rule.
Shown by a clean-machine QA run, not by this harness.
A verdict from an untrusted instrument is not a verdict. Includes SC4 (opaque-id sensitivity), SC8a (isolation attribution) and SC8b (quiet lab).
Without held-out terms, R3 measures memorisation of the training Worlds.
First-cite position bias: the largest share of first cites in any single slot must stay <= 35% (gold position is uniform, 20%). It catches a positional guesser directly.
